title: Design Notes
description: A fictional design-essay feed for JSON Feed reproduction testing.

items.title: A four-step spacing system is enough
items.content_html:
Compact, regular, loose, extra-loose — four spacing steps cover ninety percent of layout cases.

Finer steps only bring choice paralysis.

items.title: The empty state is the first greeting
items.content_html: A decent empty-state illustration plus one line of copy can cut churn noticeably.

items.title: Three strengths of haptic feedback
items.content_html: Tap, confirm, and warning each have their own vibration setting — do not mix them up.

items.title: Dark theme is not inverted colors
items.content_html:
Lower the saturation overall, turn shadows into halos, and add transparency to list dividers.

A simple color-inverted dark theme looks fake at a glance.
